Political Science and International Rela.source: AY 2026-27 catalog p.108: required POS 1001, POS 1002, POS 2013 or EUR 2013, and POS 2002 (4 courses); electives are three courses from the first list plus ten credit hours from the second (32 credit hours in total). The PDF parser attaches the 'or EUR 2013' line to POS 2002 and reads 'three courses' as the elective total.

elective_requirements.label: Program Choice
elective_requirements.rule_text: POS 2013 Comparative Politics or EUR 2013 Comparative Politics

elective_requirements.label: Elective Courses
elective_requirements.rule_text: Elective Courses (19 credit hours): three courses out of the first list below and ten credit hours from the second list.

elective_requirements.label: Three courses out of the following:
elective_requirements.rule_text: Three courses out of the following: EUR 2012 EU Politics PHI 3004 Modern and Contemporary Political Philosophy (WIC) POS 3001 Bulgarian Government and Politics POS 3003 Conflict and Conflict Resolution POS 3004 Global Political Economy POS 3005 International Law and Organizations POS 3006 Public Policy Analysis POS 3007 Research Methods (also listed as EUR 3007) POS 3008 Political Communication

elective_requirements.label: Ten credit hours from any combination of the courses listed below:
elective_requirements.rule_text: Ten credit hours from any combination of the courses listed below: POS 4[4-9]NN Topics in Politics POS 4081 Internship or one of the following: MLL 3001 Modern France—Society, Politics, and Culture MLL 3002 Modern Germany—Society, Politics, and Culture MLL 3003 Modern Spain—Society, Politics, and Culture No more than one 4000-level EUR course Example: All ten credit hours could come from taking several Topics in Politics courses that deal with different topics. Or you may instead combine one or more Topics courses with other courses in the above list. Disciplinary Honors in Political Science and International Relations To fulfill the requirements for a degree with honors in Political Science and International Relations students must have a 3.500 or higher GPA in courses counted toward the ma- jor and earn a grade of B+ or above in POS 4092 Senior Thesis. A successfully completed senior thesis substitutes for the Bulgarian State Exam, but POS 4092 does not count as credit hours earned towards a POS major.
